settings: = Settings
# Account (account)
- account text: maya@example.com [Sign out]
# Teams (teams)
- teams text: Teams = Manage your team in the account app
- teams-manage text: Invite people, roles and plans [Manage team] < https://app.cua.ai/team>
- teams-billing text: Billing [Billing and plans] < https://app.cua.ai/billing>
# General (general)
- launch-at-login toggle: Launch Cua Spaces at login {*On|Off}
- launch-at-login-note note: Keeps your Spaces and agents available after a restart.
- notch choice: Spaces tab in the notch {*Show|Hide}
- welcome text: Welcome [Show again]
# Privacy (privacy)
- telemetry choice: Share usage data to help improve Cua {*On|Off}

- telemetry-note note: Which features you use and when something goes wrong. Linked to your account through a random ID while you're signed in. Never your files, what you type or your screen. <What is collected https://cua.ai/docs/cua-sdk/concepts/telemetry>
# AI agents (agents) [Configure all detected agents] (disabled)

- experiment:classic_ui-note note: Open the previous Spaces window instead of the New UI.
